**Netherlands: scale and change.** Across 2000–2025, the extract records 576,239 applications. The largest annual volume was 45,069 in 2015; 2025 recorded 25,675. Applications in 2025 were 2.0% higher than in 2019 (25,161). In 2025, 22,855 recorded decisions equated to 89 per 100 applications, so recorded output fell below incoming volume. Applications in 2025 were 24% lower than in 2024 (33,625). Applications exceeded recorded decisions in 5 of 5 comparable years during 2021-2025. The leading recorded origins that year were Syrian Arab Rep. (3,373), Eritrea (3,178), Unknown (1,534).

In 2025, the substantive protection rate was 48%, across 15,397 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 33% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 27.7 percentage points lower than in 2024 (76%).
